document.title: Red Hat Security Advisory: example security update

notes.title: Topic
notes.text:
An update for example is now available for Red Hat Enterprise Linux 9.

Red Hat Product Security has rated this update as having a security impact of Important.

notes.title: Details
notes.text:
Example is a remote desktop client.

Security Fix(es):

* example: Denial of Service via file descriptor exhaustion (CVE-2026-0005)
